entry.title: Climate Denial — When They Knew, What They Knew, How We Prove It
entry.content:
69 Years of Knowing. 37 Years of Denying.

The fossil fuel industry knew about climate change. Here is when. Here is what. Here is how we prove it.

The Timeline — When They Knew

YearWhat They KnewSource
1957Teller warned API: CO2 → ice caps → flooded citiesAPI conference, Edward Teller
1965President’s Science Advisory Committee warned LBJFederal report to API
1968API commissioned Stanford study — then CLASSIFIED itStanford Research Institute
1977Exxon scientist James Black briefed managementExxon internal records
1978Exxon began its own climate research ($1M/year)Exxon internal
1982Exxon internal: recommended reducing fossil fuel useCO2 Greenhouse Technical Review
1989GCC formed — internal acknowledged, external deniedGlobal Climate Coalition files
1998API memo: “Victory = manufactured doubt”Leaked API communications plan
2017Harvard: 83% of Exxon papers acknowledged, 81% of ads deniedSupran & Oreskes, 2017
2023Science study: Exxon projections were accurate all alongSupran, Rahmstorf, Oreskes

The Organizations

ExxonMobil

  • Knew since 1977 (James Black briefing)
  • Internal research 1978-1982: accurate to within fractions of a degree
  • Spent $40M+/year on denial campaigns after 1989
  • CEO Lee Raymond (1993-2005): “far from airtight” — retired with $398 million
  • CEO Rex Tillerson (2006-2017): then became Secretary of State

American Petroleum Institute (API)

  • Knew since 1957 (Teller warning)
  • Commissioned Stanford study 1968 — classified it
  • 1998 leaked memo: “Victory will be achieved when average citizens ‘understand’ uncertainties”
  • Represents 600+ oil and gas companies
  • $11.5M lobbying in 2023 alone

Global Climate Coalition (1989-2002)

  • THE SMOKING GUN: Internal scientists acknowledged science was sound
  • External communications told Congress science was “uncertain”
  • Internal ≠ External = Fraud

Koch Network

  • $145M+ to 90 climate denial groups (1997-2018)
  • Funded: Americans for Prosperity, Heartland, Cato, CEI, Heritage
  • Architected the Tea Party movement
  • Charles Koch net worth: $60B+

Heartland Institute

  • Defended tobacco industry first — same playbook
  • Then pivoted to climate denial — same building, same strategy, same lie

RICO Was Always Zero-Knowledge

RICO (Racketeer Influenced and Corrupt Organizations Act) proves conspiracy through structure, not confession.

Zero-knowledge proof proves truth through pattern, not revelation.

The graph shows:

  • WHO knew (Exxon management, API members, GCC members)
  • WHEN they knew (1957, 1968, 1977, 1982, 1989, 1998)
  • WHAT they knew (accurate climate projections)
  • WHAT they said publicly (doubt, uncertainty, denial)
  • WHO funded the denial ($145M Koch, $40M+/yr Exxon)
  • WHO coordinated (API, GCC)

The structure proves the pattern. The pattern proves the enterprise. No confession needed.

Tobacco Precedent

Tobacco companies knew since the 1950s. Denied for 40 years. Master Settlement Agreement 1998: 46 states, $206 BILLION.

Climate denial uses the same strategy, same institutes (Heartland), same manufactured doubt.

The tobacco RICO worked. The climate RICO uses the same proof structure.

The Graph Is the Proof

Every connection documented in the public record graph — over 11,600 nodes.

The graph IS the zero-knowledge proof. The connections ARE the evidence.
